what: The declared matched-truncation interior-shape instrument: the corpus-breadth instrument's same state space, the same twelve english and eleven latin member roster, the same plants, floors and controls, and the same six relabeling-invariant summaries over the same mark-excluded state space (1296 ordered types, the boundary mark's row and column excluded on both sides exactly as declared there), re-priced with every simulated stream cut to the real's own counted pair mass (each band member's encoding and every plant running its frozen chain over the matched stream, cut encodings' full widths equal to the real's counted pair total and the floors' full widths exactly, streams at or below the basis whole, the real and the floors unchanged), priced under the same declared strict-all verdict rule with no assignment search anywhere in the instrument. The declared truthful question: with the band's streams matched to the real's own pair mass under the declared cut, does the real's mark-excluded profile sit inside the matched band's range on every declared invariant in every (file, language) cell, or is at least one invariant outside - the measured test of whether the interior's separation is a length artifact of the real's own counted mass or holds as the masses match. No mapping is published; nothing here is a reading.

declared.boundary_rule: the word-boundary mark's row and column are excluded from every profile's state space on both sides exactly as the boundary-mark re-instrument declared: every profile is the mark-excluded block of its pair-count matrix, 1296 ordered types, the mark located in each matrix's own alphabet (symbol 36 in every simulated encoding and the real file's own last mapped position), the full width's total recorded beside the matched rows' block profiles, and no boundary-adjusted marginal appears anywhere; the standing alphabet-width disclosure carries unchanged (the IT real transcription ranks only 23 glyph types plus the mark, so 13 of its block's 36 glyph slots are empty by width alone on the real side while the simulated alphabets are saturated at 36 in every cell)
declared.matched_truncation_rule: the matched truncation, declared before the run: the cell's real stream prices kept-adjacent pairs only (its unmapped events break adjacency), so its counted pair total is ZL 218,415, GC 183,199 and IT 220,531 pairs; the basis is that total + 1 tokens (ZL 218,416, GC 183,200, IT 220,532), and every simulated encoding (each band member's encoding and every plant's encoding) re-runs its own frozen chain, the declared draws of its row's rule, over the matched stream, the standing truncated reference's first basis tokens, so a cut stream's full width equals the real's counted pair total exactly (ZL 218,415, GC 183,199, IT 220,531), the same mass the floors already price by construction, while a stream at or below the basis stays whole; the cut takes the trailing tokens only, so the removed pair mass is bounded: ZL 247 of the standing 218,662 full-width pairs (0.11296 percent), GC 3,508 of 186,707 (1.87888 percent), IT 0; no new corpus files, no roster change, no new seed kind and no new selection anywhere
declared.roster_rule: the corpus-breadth roster stands unchanged: the same eight accepted corpus files, the same rejected candidates with their verbatim causes, the same sha256 records, the roster floor and the fetch verification are the corpus-breadth artifact's declared facts taken by reference, no corpus file is re-fetched, re-probed or re-hashed here, and the roster's streams replay through the standing declared processing with no new step (the frozen rows' plant_length values replay-match under the gate), so no roster position changes

invariants.sorted_symbol_marginals: the 36 mark-excluded glyph marginals as a multiset, stored sorted descending as counts and shares, envelope-tested by sorted position over 36 positions
invariants.sorted_pair_multiset: the 1296 mark-excluded pair counts as a multiset, stored sorted descending as counts and shares, envelope-tested by sorted position
invariants.empty_type_count: the number of the block's mark-excluded pair types with zero counted occurrences, a scalar inside [min, max]
invariants.self_pair_share: the block's diagonal sum over the profile's glyph-pair total
invariants.top_k_shares: the share of the glyph-pair total carried by the k largest pair counts, at k 1, 10 and 50
invariants.pair_entropy: the natural entropy of the mark-excluded pair distribution in nats per counted glyph pair

declared.state_note: every profile here is the mark-excluded block of the same pair-count matrices the boundary-mark instrument priced: the real's kept-adjacent pairs and the encodings' full streams keep their structural difference, every share-valued invariant normalises by its own glyph-pair total, and the empty type count is a raw count tied to its own total and recorded in that context; the plaintext control's state is the 27 reference letters alone (729 types, no boundary mark) and takes no part in any envelope; the latin envelopes stay size-mixed by the roster's own declared construction (the below-basis members replay whole, so the matched member streams run 45,490 pairs upward), and the IT cells carry the declared degenerate case exactly: their basis equals the standing truncated length because the real transcription holds no unmapped events, so every IT matched fact equals its standing fact and the IT matched verdict is the corpus-breadth verdict replayed
declared.machinery_rule: this instrument contains no assignment search anywhere: no candidate evaluation, no restarts, no sweep cap, no convergence flags; the standing budgets are not applicable and no machinery recording appears for that reason
declared.split_rule: no split applies: a profile uses every counted pair of its stream after the declared exclusion; the climb and score halves of the band instruments have no counterpart here
declared.seed_kinds: the standing encoding, plant and floor kinds replay at their frozen positions with their frozen selected draws exactly as every predecessor declared; each matched encoding runs its own frozen chain's declared draws over the matched stream from draw 0 upward; no new seed is consumed and no draw selection is performed
declared.seed_sharing: the standing-basis facts (every member row's anchors, every plant's standing row, every floor row and the standing plaintext control) replay through the declared chains and verify against the frozen corpus-breadth artifact field for field under the gate; the matched facts run the same seeds over the matched streams from draw 0 upward; every block profile of every matched row is the declared block of its own replayed matched encoding
declared.matched_band_record_rule: the simulated band per language cell stays the corpus-breadth roster's twelve english and eleven latin members, unconditional, priced at the matched basis: each member row carries its standing-basis anchors (file, ebook, plant_length, selected_draw_index, draw_rule, and the standing encoding's own full width, gate-anchored to the frozen corpus-breadth rows) and its matched facts (matched length, matched total and matched profile, the row's priced profile), the matched total an exact identity, matched length - 1, of every row; the standing members re-run their frozen selected-draw counts at the matched length and the breadth members run their declared draw 0 there, and no draw selection is performed anywhere
declared.plants_rule: the 30 plant encodings (5 per cell, the standing first references at the standing kinds) recorded at the matched basis like the band: each row carries its standing full width (the standing encoding's own, gate-anchored to the frozen corpus-breadth rows), its matched length, its matched total (the same exact identity) and its matched glyph-block profile; the plants_at_source_identity boolean reports the standing widths at the standing lengths, and each matched row carries the same identity at its matched length; no parity rule applies because there is no anchor geometry to exceed
declared.floors_rule: the 30 destroyed-adjacency floors recorded as identical replays: a floor's full width is the shuffled kept-adjacency structure's own pair count, the real's counted pair total exactly, so the floors already sit at the matched scale everywhere and nothing here re-cuts them; their glyph-block profiles replay under the gate; their declared role is the shuffled-structure control recorded beside the verdict, not part of any envelope
declared.plaintext_rule: each cell records the standing truncated reference's own plaintext stream profile (replay-verified against the frozen records) and its matched control re-cut to the basis beside it (plaintext_matched_profile), both computed by the same formulas on the 27-type letter state (729 types, no boundary mark), as the prose control beside the verdict; neither control takes part in any envelope
declared.verdict_rule: declared strict-all, unchanged: a cell is shape-consistent-with-homophonic-encoding only when every declared invariant of the real's glyph-block profile sits inside the closed range of that cell's matched band's glyph-block profiles (the two vector summaries term by term inside the band's per-position envelope over 36 sorted positions, the scalar summaries inside [min, max] at the stored 6-decimal rounding); any outside invariant makes the cell shape-outside-analogues, and every outside entry is recorded with its band range so the miss is audited not summarized
declared.closure_rule: no scalar margin is formed: this instrument's question is inside or outside per invariant, and the recorded distances are the outside entries' band ranges themselves
declared.exclusion_rule: the family's declared exclusion format is not re-scoped by this artifact: it keys to the declared 36-slot class under the inherited add-one form exactly as the held-out screen declared it, so a search-free verdict is structure evidence and the band instruments' verdicts stand untouched by this artifact's numbers
declared.bridge_gate: before any profile is priced, every fact this instrument re-derives fresh that a frozen predecessor already recorded must equal that stored value field for field: the corpus-breadth instrument's 399 anchor fields exactly as that instrument declared them (the boundary-mark gate's 288 anchors and the 111 standing profile checks), then per cell the frozen corpus-breadth rows' standing replays verified against fresh re-derivations: each member row (file, ebook, plant_length, selected_draw_index, draw_rule, full-width total and block profile) replayed through its declared chain, each plant row (index, plant_length, standing full-width total and block profile), each floor row (index, full-width total and block profile), each plaintext control's standing profile, and each cell's real record's eight declared fields, 24 row checks per english cell and 23 per latin cell, 141 row checks total; the matched facts carry no frozen counterpart and ride on the declared roster; any divergence aborts with nothing written
declared.models_rule: no score table is built or used: the instrument prices count structure only, so the standing add-one and leave-one-out tables play no part anywhere in this artifact
